section_title: Marine atmosphere: carbon steel, coating and stainless steel
text: Outdoor carbon steel equipment and structures shall be coated with a C5 coating system of durability H in accordance with ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0002; hot-dip galvanising per EN ISO 1461 for structural steel, gratings and supports in accordance with ER-13.03, with an additional coating in the splash zone and where chloride deposition is above the maximum stated in DP-OWNR-0007.
